versions.changelog:
- Updated for compatibility with new cargo-project skill and changed requirements from cargo-cdk to cargo-project.
- Updated documentation and setup instructions in SKILL.md and README.md to reflect Cargo project terminology and commands.
- Adjusted example setup steps and commands to use cargo-ai project instead of cargo-ai cdk.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.
- Minor wording and metadata updates throughout documentation for clarity and accuracy.

- Updated version to 0.1.2.
- Shortened and clarified the top-level description for easier understanding.
- Revised triggers in the description for added clarity and completeness.
- Removed redundant or less-relevant trigger examples.
- Deleted unnecessary file: skill-card.md.

Initial release of new-hire-detection.

- Detects when people in your target market take a role you sell to and qualifies their new company against your ICP.
- Automatically posts qualifying new hires to Slack with context, rationale, and relevant links.
- Works as a deployable pipeline using a Sales Navigator job-change search (no LinkedIn seat required).
- Optional variations to check/write to a CRM (HubSpot supported by default; Salesforce/Attio adaptable).
- Requires the cargo-cdk skill, authenticated connectors (Sales Navigator, LinkedIn, LLM, Slack; CRM optional).
- Out-of-the-box play ends at Slack—no CRM or person contact unless adapted.
